title: Length hysteresis + priority bins for continuous batcher to reduce KV fragmentation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Mixed-length traffic (short prompts with long generation vs long prompts with short responses) is causing repeated KV cache fragmentation and slot thrash on GPU pools. This ticket implements length-hysteresis and priority binning in the continuous batcher to stabilize slot allocation, reduce KV eviction churn, and reclaim usable GPU memory for higher-utilization packing.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end experiment showing >=14% reduction in KV cache evictions on the test cluster for mixed-length workload
P50 generation latency for short-critical requests remains within 5% of baseline under 90th percentile load
GPU memory fragmentation metric (per-GPU free contiguous slab) improves by >=10% versus current baseline
Implementation behind feature flag and rollout plan documented; automatic rollback path verified
Unit and integration tests for hysteresis boundaries and bin transitions included
implementation_notes: Add length-hysteresis window to batcher length classifier: requests only move to a shorter/longer length bin after N consecutive observations (configurable, default N=3)
Introduce priority bins: reserve a small fraction of slots for low-latency short requests (configurable percentage per pool)
When bin-populations change, perform KV compaction: mark cold KV shards for eviction in a deferred epoch to avoid immediate thrash
GPU slab manager: implement best-effort coalescing after eviction sweeps; add synchronous compaction API for canary runs
Metrics: add kv_evictions_by_bin, slot_moves_per_minute, contiguous_free_slab_bytes, hysteresis_state_transitions
Fallback policy: if reserved short-slot utilization < 30% after 5 minutes, reduce reservation by 50% to avoid wasted capacity
Feature-flag gate: runtime flag continuous_batcher.hysteresis_enabled + cluster-level override via config service

2026-01-27 - Eng sync: Decided to add deferred KV compaction epoch (default 2s) to avoid compaction-induced latency spikes. Action: add compaction throttling token bucket.

risks: Over-reserving slots for short requests could reduce overall throughput under heavy long-context workloads; mitigation: dynamic shrink policy after grace period
Deferred KV compaction could temporarily increase memory use; mitigation: compaction token bucket and synchronous canary compaction
Hysteresis parameters mis-tuned may delay reactions to actual workload shifts; mitigation: expose parameters and ship with conservative defaults
